Package testing

Class ContributorTestingAutomation

java.lang.Object
testing.ContributorTestingAutomation
public class ContributorTestingAutomation extends Object

Title: ContributorTestingAutomation Class.

Description: Semi-automated testing testbed modeled after the Foundations PasswordEvaluationTestingAutomation architecture. Executes 28 positive and negative test cases across all 12 Phase Two (TP2) Contributor requirements (TP2-REQ-01 through TP2-REQ-12), covering LessonLearned entity construction, LessonLearnedList CRUD operations, ContributorValidator input boundary checks, ownership authorization guards, and TP3 forward-compatible moderation, endorsement, and verification hooks.

Requirement Coverage Summary:

  • TP2-REQ-01 (US-HW2-01 Create Entity & Master Insertion): performTestCase01_CreateValidLesson(), performTestCase02_CreateNullLesson(), performTestCase03_CreateDuplicateIdLesson()
  • TP2-REQ-02 (US-HW2-01 Title Input Boundary Validation): performTestCase04_ValidateValidTitleBoundaries(), performTestCase05_ValidateBlankAndShortTitle(), performTestCase06_ValidateOversizedTitle()
  • TP2-REQ-03 (US-HW2-01 Description Input Boundary Validation): performTestCase07_ValidateValidDescriptionBoundaries(), performTestCase08_ValidateBlankAndShortDescription(), performTestCase09_ValidateOversizedDescription()
  • TP2-REQ-04 (US-HW2-01 Category & Author Input Validation): performTestCase10_ValidateValidCategoryAndAuthor(), performTestCase11_ValidateInvalidCategoryAndAuthor()
  • TP2-REQ-05 (US-HW2-02 Read All Lessons & Primary Key Lookup): performTestCase12_ReadAllAndFindExistingId(), performTestCase13_ReadNonExistentIdAndUnmodifiableView()
  • TP2-REQ-06 (US-HW2-02 Keyword Search Across Arbitrary Subset Sizes): performTestCase14_SearchKeywordMultiAndSingleSubset(), performTestCase15_SearchKeywordEmptySubset(), performTestCase16_SearchKeywordBlankResetAndOversizedQuery()
  • TP2-REQ-07 (US-HW2-02 Category Filter Operations): performTestCase17_FilterCategoryMatchingAndAllReset(), performTestCase18_FilterCategoryNoMatchEmptySubset()
  • TP2-REQ-08 (US-HW2-03 Update Existing Lesson & Subset Synchronization): performTestCase19_UpdateValidLessonAndSyncSubset(), performTestCase20_UpdateInvalidFieldsAndNonExistentId()
  • TP2-REQ-09 (US-HW2-03 Update Ownership & Role Authorization): performTestCase21_AuthorizeUpdateByOriginalAuthorAndAdmin(), performTestCase22_RejectUpdateByUnauthorizedContributor()
  • TP2-REQ-10 (US-HW2-04 Delete Existing Lesson & Subset Synchronization): performTestCase23_DeleteValidLessonFromMasterAndSubset(), performTestCase24_DeleteNonExistentAndNegativeId()
  • TP2-REQ-11 (US-HW2-04 Delete Ownership & Role Authorization): performTestCase25_AuthorizeDeleteByOriginalAuthorAndAdmin(), performTestCase26_RejectDeleteByUnauthorizedContributor()
  • TP2-REQ-12 (TP3 Epics Forward-Compatible Governance Hooks): performTestCase27_VerifyTP3ModerationEndorsementAndVerification(), performTestCase28_RejectTP3HooksOnNonExistentId()

    • performTestCase01_CreateValidLesson

      public static void performTestCase01_CreateValidLesson()

      Method: performTestCase01_CreateValidLesson() [POSITIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-01 (US-HW2-01 Acceptance Criterion e: Create and insert a valid LessonLearned entity into the master collection).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Instantiates a LessonLearned object with valid ID (101), title ("H2 Database Lock Fix"), description ("Close active H2 connections in stop() to prevent lock file errors."), author ("Sanidhya"), and category ("Database"), then invokes LessonLearnedList.addLesson(LessonLearned) to store the entity in the synchronized allLessons list.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-01 | TP2-REQ-01 | POSITIVE] followed by the return value of addLesson and the updated master count. The test passes if addLesson returns true, getTotalCount() equals 1, and the console outputs ***Success*** TC-01 Passed; otherwise it outputs ***Failure*** TC-01 Failed.

    • performTestCase02_CreateNullLesson

      public static void performTestCase02_CreateNullLesson()

      Method: performTestCase02_CreateNullLesson() [NEGATIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-01 (US-HW2-01 Defensive null entity rejection during Create operation).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Calls LessonLearnedList.addLesson(LessonLearned) with a null reference. Inside addLesson, the guard condition if (lesson == null) return false; intercepts the null input before acquiring the collection lock, preventing null elements from corrupting allLessons.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-02 | TP2-REQ-01 | NEGATIVE]. The test passes if addLesson(null) returns false, getTotalCount() remains 0, and the console outputs ***Success*** TC-02 Passed.

    • performTestCase03_CreateDuplicateIdLesson

      public static void performTestCase03_CreateDuplicateIdLesson()

      Method: performTestCase03_CreateDuplicateIdLesson() [NEGATIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-01 (US-HW2-01 Primary key uniqueness enforcement during Create operation).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Inserts an initial LessonLearned with ID 101, then attempts to insert a second LessonLearned sharing the same primary key ID 101. The guard if (lesson.getId() > 0 && findById(lesson.getId()).isPresent()) return false; detects the collision and rejects the duplicate entry.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-03 | TP2-REQ-01 | NEGATIVE]. The test passes if the first insertion returns true, the duplicate insertion returns false, getTotalCount() stays 1, and the console displays ***Success*** TC-03 Passed.

    • performTestCase04_ValidateValidTitleBoundaries

      public static void performTestCase04_ValidateValidTitleBoundaries()

      Method: performTestCase04_ValidateValidTitleBoundaries() [POSITIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-02 (US-HW2-01 Title length boundary validation for minimum 4 characters, typical length, and maximum 64 characters).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Invokes ContributorValidator.validateTitle(String) with an exact 4-character title ("Java"), a standard descriptive title, and an exact 64-character title. validateTitle trims whitespace, checks length >= 4 && length <= 64, and returns an empty string "" when valid.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-04 | TP2-REQ-02 | POSITIVE]. The test passes if all three boundary strings return "" (empty error string) and the console outputs ***Success*** TC-04 Passed.

    • performTestCase05_ValidateBlankAndShortTitle

      public static void performTestCase05_ValidateBlankAndShortTitle()

      Method: performTestCase05_ValidateBlankAndShortTitle() [NEGATIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-02 (US-HW2-01 Rejection of null, blank, and under-length titles < 4 characters).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Passes " " (whitespace-only) and "Bug" (3 characters) to ContributorValidator.validateTitle(String). The validator trims the input, detects isEmpty() and length < 4, and returns context-relevant error messages.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-05 | TP2-REQ-02 | NEGATIVE]. The test passes if both inputs return non-empty diagnostic error strings containing "cannot be blank" and "too short", and the console prints ***Success*** TC-05 Passed.

    • performTestCase06_ValidateOversizedTitle

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-02 (US-HW2-01 Rejection of titles exceeding the 64-character upper boundary).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Constructs a 65-character title string and passes it to ContributorValidator.validateTitle(String). The condition if (length > 64) triggers and returns an error message specifying that the title must be between 4 and 64 characters.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-06 | TP2-REQ-02 | NEGATIVE]. The test passes if the returned error string contains "too long" and "between 4 and 64", and the console displays ***Success*** TC-06 Passed.

    • performTestCase12_ReadAllAndFindExistingId

      public static void performTestCase12_ReadAllAndFindExistingId()

      Method: performTestCase12_ReadAllAndFindExistingId() [POSITIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-05 (US-HW2-02 Acceptance Criterion a: Retrieve complete master collection and locate specific lesson by primary key ID).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Populates a LessonLearnedList with 3 realistic course lessons, calls LessonLearnedList.getAllLessons() to read the full collection, and invokes LessonLearnedList.findById(int) for ID 202.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-12 | TP2-REQ-05 | POSITIVE]. The test passes if getAllLessons().size() equals 3, findById(202).isPresent() is true with matching title, and the console outputs ***Success*** TC-12 Passed.

    • performTestCase13_ReadNonExistentIdAndUnmodifiableView

      public static void performTestCase13_ReadNonExistentIdAndUnmodifiableView()

      Method: performTestCase13_ReadNonExistentIdAndUnmodifiableView() [NEGATIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-05 (US-HW2-02 Safe handling of non-existent primary key lookups and protection of internal collection state against unvalidated external mutation).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Calls LessonLearnedList.findById(int) with non-existent ID 9999 (returning Optional.empty()), and attempts to call clear() directly on the list view returned by LessonLearnedList.getAllLessons(), which throws UnsupportedOperationException due to Collections.unmodifiableList.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-13 | TP2-REQ-05 | NEGATIVE]. The test passes if findById(9999).isEmpty() is true, external mutation is blocked by UnsupportedOperationException, and the console outputs ***Success*** TC-13 Passed.

    • performTestCase14_SearchKeywordMultiAndSingleSubset

      public static void performTestCase14_SearchKeywordMultiAndSingleSubset()

      Method: performTestCase14_SearchKeywordMultiAndSingleSubset() [POSITIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-06 (US-HW2-02 Acceptance Criteria b & d: Case-insensitive keyword search producing multi-item and single-item subsets).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Calls LessonLearnedList.searchByKeyword(String) with "javafx" (matching 2 records across title and description case-insensitively) and then with "branch" (matching exactly 1 record), verifying LessonLearnedList.getSubsetSize() and LessonLearnedList.isSubsetEmpty().

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-14 | TP2-REQ-06 | POSITIVE]. The test passes if the first search yields subset size 2, the second search yields subset size 1, and the console outputs ***Success*** TC-14 Passed.

    • performTestCase15_SearchKeywordEmptySubset

      public static void performTestCase15_SearchKeywordEmptySubset()

      Method: performTestCase15_SearchKeywordEmptySubset() [NEGATIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-06 (US-HW2-02 Acceptance Criterion e: Graceful handling of 0-match empty search subsets without null pointer exceptions).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Invokes LessonLearnedList.searchByKeyword(String) with unmatched query "nonexistent_quantum_kernel". searchByKeyword populates currentSubset with an empty list rather than returning null, and isSubsetEmpty() returns true.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-15 | TP2-REQ-06 | NEGATIVE]. The test passes if getSubsetSize() == 0 and isSubsetEmpty() == true, and outputs ***Success*** TC-15 Passed.

    • performTestCase19_UpdateValidLessonAndSyncSubset

      public static void performTestCase19_UpdateValidLessonAndSyncSubset()

      Method: performTestCase19_UpdateValidLessonAndSyncSubset() [POSITIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-08 (US-HW2-03 Acceptance Criteria a, b, d: Update mutable fields of an existing lesson and synchronize changes into active subset).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Filters the list so lesson 201 is present in currentSubset, then calls LessonLearnedList.updateLesson(int, String, String, String) with valid new title, description, and category. updateLesson validates the boundaries, mutates the entity, and calls refreshSubsetElement to keep currentSubset synchronized.

    • performTestCase22_RejectUpdateByUnauthorizedContributor

      public static void performTestCase22_RejectUpdateByUnauthorizedContributor()

      Method: performTestCase22_RejectUpdateByUnauthorizedContributor() [NEGATIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-09 (US-HW2-03 Block unauthorized contributors from modifying lessons authored by other team members).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Targets Lesson 201 authored by "Sanidhya" and invokes ContributorValidator.verifyModifyPermission(LessonLearned, User) with non-admin contributor "PeerUserBob".     • performTestCase23_DeleteValidLessonFromMasterAndSubset

      public static void performTestCase23_DeleteValidLessonFromMasterAndSubset()

      Method: performTestCase23_DeleteValidLessonFromMasterAndSubset() [POSITIVE TEST]

      Requirements Tested: TP2-REQ-10 (US-HW2-04 Acceptance Criteria a & b: Expel a lesson by primary key ID from both the master collection and active subset).

      How the Code Implements Satisfaction of the Requirements: Executes a search so Lesson 202 is inside currentSubset, then calls LessonLearnedList.deleteLesson(int) with ID 202. deleteLesson removes the matching record from both allLessons and currentSubset.

      How to Interpret the Output to Know if the Test Passed: The console prints [TC-23 | TP2-REQ-10 | POSITIVE]. The test passes if deleteLesson(202) returns true, findById(202).isEmpty() is true, getTotalCount() drops from 3 to 2, and getSubsetSize() drops to 0, printing ***Success*** TC-23 Passed.

    • performTestCase24_DeleteNonExistentAndNegativeId

      public static void performTestCase24_DeleteNonExistentAndNegativeId()
